selected_behavior.containers: Barrel, chest and trapped chest; selected literal/basic-style title and exact plain custom-name lock controls.

selected_behavior.main_hand: Empty hand, wrong custom_name and matching item_name deny; the matching custom_name key and empty lock predicate open.
selected_behavior.offhand_creative_spectator: Offhand key alone denies, a real hand swap opens, creative empty hand denies, and spectator bypass applies only to materialized contents.
selected_behavior.pending_loot: Wrong key and spectator denial retain the named empty loot table and Long seed; the correct key unpacks it.
selected_behavior.deposit_restart: A real slot-2/hotbar-1 SWAP deposits five gold ingots and empties the player slot. Selected title, exact lock and recursively merged opaque custom data survive a clean restart; final raw MCA metadata independently matches.
selected_behavior.double_containers: Both mismatched halves deny from both clicked sides; RIGHT/FIRST title selection and LEFT fallback open from either side.
selected_behavior.privacy: Selected received chunk entries omit private container NBT. These remain runtime decoded observations; raw chunk packets were not retained.
selected_behavior.wire_scope: 176 selected OpenScreen, contents and slot payloads independently decoded and correlated to direct client logs. Deposit SWAP raw headers match menu/state; predicted-stack hash tails are retained without decoding.
